# Berkeley Wellbeing

> Berkeley Wellbeing provides science-based wellness resources, training programs, and private label rights content for entrepreneurs and coaches building impact-driven businesses.

Founded by Dr. Tchiki Davis, Berkeley Wellbeing combines developmental psychology and well-being practices with business tools for wellness entrepreneurs. The site offers flagship products including The Path to Well-Being book, Well-Being Strategist certification training, and comprehensive PLR content packages designed to help coaches and entrepreneurs scale their impact.

## Key Topics

- Private Label Rights (PLR)
- Well-Being Strategist Training
- Path to Well-Being
- Developmental Psychology
- Wellness Entrepreneurship
- Done-for-You Content
- Coaching Business
- Impact Entrepreneurship
- Economic Justice
- Marginalized Entrepreneurs
- PLR Courses
- PLR Social Media
- Awakening Collective
- The Four Stages of Enlightenment
- Business Resources

## Flagship Programs & Training

- [Well-Being Strategist Training](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/well-being-strategist-summer-training.html): 10-week Well-Being Strategist certification training led by Dr. Tchiki Davis.
- [The Path To Well-Being Book](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/path-to-well-being-book.html): Path to Well-Being book and workbook on developmental psychology and personal growth.

## PLR Content & Resources for Entrepreneurs

- [All Access Pass PLR](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/all-access-pass-plr.html): All Access Pass PLR product with science-based content for wellness entrepreneurs.
- [PLR Wellness Courses](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/plr-wellness-courses.html): Science-based PLR courses for exponential wellness business growth.
- [PLR Wellness Content](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/plr-wellness-content.html): Science-based PLR content packages for wellness business growth and impact.
- [Social Media Posts](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/plr-social-media-posts.html): Science-based PLR social media content packages for wellness entrepreneurs.
- [Other PLR Well-Being Content](https://www.berkeleywellbeing.com/plr-wellbeing-content-other.html): PLR worksheets, ebooks, and digital resources for wellness coaches.
